pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: YOU HAVE A MESSAGE FROM SPECIAL CLASS ARIMA.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HE SAID "I WILL BE RETURNING THE BOOK I BORROWED SO TELL ME A CONVENIENT TIME."

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ....THOUGH IT'S FINE NOT TO DO IT PERSONALLY, SINCE WE'RE ALL BUSY.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: JEEZ, IS HE BEING CONSCIEN- TIOUS, OR NANT... AH, THAT "NANT" CAN HAVE ANOTHER "NAN" IN IT... 1 GET IT. SHUT UP.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: HE WANTS TO MEET YOU AFTER SUCH A LONG WHILE, DOESN'T HE? IT'S LIKE A "PARENTAL LOVE".

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: I WONDER IF THAT GUY HAS THAT SORT OF FEELING...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I'LL TRY GOING OVER THERE WHEN THE INVESTIGATION CALMS DOWN.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: THE TRUE POWER WHICH HAS RECEIVED THE WHITE WING MEDAL IS NOT JUST FOR SHOW. I AM ALSO HOPING YOU'LL BE THE MADO SQUAD'S ACE. STRIVE FOR THAT, RANK 1 SASAKI.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HOW ABOUT I STRIVE FOR A HUG?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: DID YOU DROP BY SHIBA- SENSEI'S PLACE?

pages.speaker: character7
pages.text: MY ANEMIA WAS ACTING UP AGAIN...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THERE WAS AN INCIDENT OF "GROWLING SOUNDS OF A BEAST" BEING HEARD FROM THE NEIGHBORHOOD, AND THE LADY WAS WORRIED THAT "IT MIGHT BE A GHOUL".….

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: BUT, AS A RESULT OF RANK 3 YONE- BAYASHI AND I INVESTIGATING AROUND THE AREA,

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WE ASCERTAINED THAT IN TRUTH IT WAS JUST A STRAY DOG, THAT HAD MADE THE NEIGHBOR- HOOD ITS HOME, GROWLING BEHIND THE LADY'S HOUSE. briskly So it was,just a beast.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WHEN WE INFORMED THE LADY OF THAT SHE SAID "FROM TODAY ON, I'LL BE ABLE TO SLEEP SOUNDLY" AND WAS EXTREMELY RELIEVED.
